name: good
description: A good program on the first try (the default scenario).

steps.text:
# dark techno with an acid line, 24 bars (a recorded answer of the fake model)
tempo 128
key am
let kk = x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~
let hh = ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~
let acid = a2 ~ a2 a2 ~ c3 ~ a2 e2 ~ e2 g2 ~ e2 ~ e2
section intro 8 bars {
  deck A: kick kk vel=100 | hihat hh vel=60..85
  deck B: harmony chord(am) inst=warm-pad len=16 vel=80
  master: filter lp 400 -> 6000 over 8 bars
}
section drop 16 bars {
  master: filter off
  deck A: kick kk vel=112 | hihat hh vel=70..95 | bass acid inst=wobble-lead
  deck B: harmony chord(am) inst=warm-pad len=16 vel=80
}
arrange intro drop
